body:
A proposal that edits a record names it only by id when the edit doesn't change its title, so the note left after it is answered reads like "Proposal: Change task f81ea561a5792d67". Show the record's title too.

- The proposal's question, and the note it leaves once answered, name the record's current title beside its id, whatever fields the edit changes. This applies to tasks, features and milestones.
- An edit that changes the title still names it.

`tasks::strategy.proposal` adds the title only from the proposed `fields`; the current record (`current`) is already read there.

**Tests:** an edit proposal that doesn't change the title names the current one in its question and in the answered note.
title: proposals: name the record's title
